So that claim is not grounded. So there is a grounding issue.

5. FALSE PREMISE: Premises: patients with SEVERE disease exist. Data shows severity includes severe. So premise true. Biomarker baseline column contains values in ng/mL (units). Data dictionary says baseline is ng/mL. So fine.

Thus only issue: grounding of patient count. Also maybe they didn't provide evidence for count; but they could have derived it but not printed. Since not shown, it's not grounded. So verdict revise, issue: unsupported claim about number of severe patients.
